name: USDCHF Mean Reversion - Low Volatility Bollinger Band Strategy
description: Mean reversion strategy for USDCHF that trades when price reaches Bollinger Band extremes during low volatility periods (low ATR). Enters both long and short positions, exits when price returns to the mean.
source:
# USDCHF Mean Reversion - Low Volatility Bollinger Band Strategy
# Mean reversion during quiet markets using Bollinger Band extremes

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2 std dev)
bb = bbands(period=20, stddev=2)(close)
lower_band = bb.bbands_lower
middle_band = bb.bbands_middle
upper_band = bb.bbands_upper

# ATR (14-period default)
atr_value = atr(period=14)()

# Low volatility filter: ATR below its 20-period moving average
atr_ma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(atr_value)
is_low_volatility = atr_value < atr_ma

# Entry conditions
# Long: Price at or below lower band during low volatility
long_entry_signal = (close <= lower_band) and is_low_volatility

# Short: Price at or above upper band during low volatility
short_entry_signal = (close >= upper_band) and is_low_volatility

# Exit conditions
# Long exit: Price returns to middle band (crosses above)
long_exit_signal = close >= middle_band

# Short exit: Price returns to middle band (crosses below)
short_exit_signal = close <= middle_band

# Hold signals from entry to exit
long_held = hold_until()(enter=long_entry_signal, exit=long_exit_signal)
short_held = hold_until()(enter=short_entry_signal, exit=short_exit_signal)

# Execution zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_held, short_entry=short_held)

# Position sizing: 10% per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=10)
